{{Quote|I'm developing a serum that neutralizes Killik larvae&mdash;toxic membrosia nectar, technically. Pump it into an egg, the babies feed; no more nest.|Imodin Ganalya|<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Exterminator|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Mother's Milk project''' was a [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetically engineered]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that was being developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Named after an [[Mother's Milk|Alderaanian nursery rhyme]], a prototype of the toxin was created by [[Imodin Ganalya]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] with the express purpose of using it as a bio-weapon against the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. The poison worked by being injected directly within Killik eggs, where they prevented the young from hatching, thus eliminating them.

The prototype serum was manufactured and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] attempted to field test it, but their entire field operations team was lost during the mission. Thus, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Ganalya tasked an Imperial official with delivering the poison. Following the successful completion of this task, it was believed the Mother's Milk serum was going to be capable of depopulating an entire Killik nest with thousands of the insectoid aliens failing to hatch from their eggs.
